call_input.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Create one finished independent flat launch poster for a fictional folding cup, portrait 4:5. This is a single poster artwork filling the whole image, with editorial typography and a real-photograph-like product action photograph. 요청한 화면 비율을 유지하면서 현재 도구와 모델이 지원하는 가능한 최대 해상도로 출력.

Visual argument: the physical shortening of a flexible silicone cup under a hand's downward pressure makes foldability immediately understandable. The first impression should be the in-progress squeeze and the large compact FOLN identity, with the existing action phrase closely relating to the movement, then the capacity/material and launch/preorder information. No decorative metaphor is needed.

Product and photograph: show exactly ONE handleless 350mL folding cup with a matte dark forest-green silicone body. Its circular upper rim, continuous walls, accordion fold rings and stable closed base must clearly remain a cup. Photograph the cup midway through axial collapse: lower accordion rings are nested close together, one upper ring is still partly extended and visibly deforming under downward force. It sits on a pale warm-grey studio tabletop, anchoring its bottom with a soft contact shadow. A believable adult bare hand enters from the upper right, cropped at the wrist: its palm heel and two relaxed fingers make clear contact with the thick green top rim to press it downward. Keep the hand anatomy natural, skin texture real, and enough of the cup wall visible to read the connected folds. Do not show a fully crushed bag shape or disconnected rings. A detached translucent-white lid belonging to this same cup rests on the tabletop immediately to the cup's left, slightly tilted so its shallow disk shape, matching diameter and frosted translucent material are legible. The open cup rim remains visible under the hand. The cup and lid have absolutely no writing, symbols, branding or surface marks. No second cup, no duplicate product states.

Composition and typography: photograph the action from a slightly elevated front three-quarter viewpoint with real lens perspective, soft directional daylight-like studio lighting from upper left, natural skin, diffuse silicone sheen and a gently luminous frosted lid. Let the cup form an abbreviated vertical column near center-left while the forearm enters diagonally from right; the pressure gesture aims into the space beneath the identity. Use the entire poster as a continuous pale warm-grey field, without panels or picture frames. Set “FOLN” as a very large, heavy, compact black-green sans-serif word across the upper left, clean ordinary lettering rather than an invented logo. Place “Fold Cup” at medium size aligned below the left edge of FOLN. Set the Korean action phrase in two clean lines at the upper right, aligned to the path of the entering wrist but never distorted, curved or crushed. Allocate enough clear unoccluded space below the photograph for the smaller information: capacity/material is the leading product descriptor, release date is bold, preorder window beneath it, URL at the bottom. The information should be visibly grouped by meaning rather than equally sized list lines; all essential detail should remain readable at 720px poster width. Maintain deliberate margins, clear Korean strokes, real word spacing, optical alignment and generous spacing between the commerce lines. Hands, cup, shadows and photo must not cover any type.

Display EXACTLY the following seven supplied copy items, each once, with this wording, visible spaces, punctuation, digits, mixed Korean/English, middle dot and en dash. Line wrapping at word boundaries is allowed, with no alterations to text and no additional titles:
FOLN
Fold Cup
가볍게 접고, 다시 펼치다
350 mL · 접이식 실리콘 컵
2026.12.01 RELEASE
온라인 사전 주문 11.10–11.30
foln.example/store

Avoid all extra copy, labels, numbering, badges, arrows, ornaments, invented logos, real brands, microtext, signatures, watermarks, collage, mockup context, paper texture effects and artificial glow. Keep the image a flat completed portrait poster with one physically coherent action photograph and all seven exact copy items.
